core_categories: Emergency Medical Products; Trauma and First Aid; Diagnostics and Monitoring; Airway and Oxygen/Resuscitation; Cases/Bags/Kits; Immobilization and Patient Handling; EMS Medications and Pharmaceuticals
specialty_focus: Life-Assist is a full-line distributor of emergency medical products, supplies, and equipment, serving pre-hospital care providers such as first responders, paramedics, EMTs, fire departments, law enforcement, and parks/recreation services. It does not manufacture its own products but acts as a middleman distributor carrying prominent industry brands. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: MERET, Statpacks, PAX, Fieldtex, Iron Duck, Pelican Boxes, Ferno, Conterra, Thomas, Unimed, others
